'''2003 Massachusetts State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held at Scholar's Books and Games in Bridgewater, Massachusetts, on 19 July 2003.<ref name="pc-us03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Paul Maholick]] was the tournament director.<ref name="pc-us03" /> According to his forum signature (captured March 2004), [[Michael Pistone]] was the "2003 Massachusetts State Champion".<ref name="pcf-2588-38902">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38902#38902 MERRY CHRISTMAS, SWCCGPC!], Michael Pistone, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 December 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306022118/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38909%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1302-23894">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23894#23894 Live Coverage UPDATE #5], Michael Pistone, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625214828/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23900%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

The [[Players Committee]]'s 2003 State, Provincial and National Championships were the Level 1 events of its 2003 Championship Circuit; each awarded a bye into the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]].<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Bridgewater, Massachusetts
* '''Dates:''' 19 July 2003<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Scholar's Books and Games, Bridgewater<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Time:''' 12pm<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Paul Maholick]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
